orgs.title: NVIDIA NGC Organizations
orgs.description: NGC organizations, teams, users and team members, role grants, invitations and the current user (source: the NGC API definition harvested from the API explorer).

private_registry.title: NVIDIA NGC Private Registry
private_registry.description: Org-scoped artifact metadata in the NGC private registry: models, resources, recipes, generic artifacts (containers, helm charts), versions and files, collections, shares, deployment parameters, encryption keys and workflows. Team-scoped twins are mapped as *_by_team methods (source: the Private Artifacts (Models) API definition, responses from the ngcsdk data classes).

catalog.title: NVIDIA NGC Catalog
catalog.description: The public NGC catalog: guest reads of models, resources, recipes, helm charts, collections and generic artifacts, plus the GPU and cloud service provider catalogs (no organization scope; public artifacts read without credentials).

nvcf_functions.title: NVIDIA Cloud Functions - Functions
nvcf_functions.description: NVCF functions and versions, function metadata, authorizations (function sharing grants), secrets and rate limits (source: the published NVCF OpenAPI specification; management operations served from api.ngc.nvidia.com).

nvcf_deployments.title: NVIDIA Cloud Functions - Deployments
nvcf_deployments.description: NVCF deployments and GPU specifications, cluster groups and GPU inventory, registry credentials and telemetry endpoints (source: the published NVCF OpenAPI specification; served from api.ngc.nvidia.com).

nvcf_queues.title: NVIDIA Cloud Functions - Queues
nvcf_queues.description: NVCF request queue details per function and version, and queue position per request (served from api.nvcf.nvidia.com).

nvcf_invocation.title: NVIDIA Cloud Functions - Invocation
nvcf_invocation.description: NVCF HTTP-polling invocation (pexec and status), assets and invocation assertion tokens (served from api.nvcf.nvidia.com).
